info.title: FertiMata Backend API
info.description:
Backend for the FertiMata smart-agriculture platform.

The backend is the application layer between the operator PWA and the IoT
infrastructure. Clients use REST for queries and commands, and the STOMP
WebSocket endpoint for realtime updates. Clients never talk to MQTT and never
see hardware details.

**Realtime (STOMP over WebSocket at `/ws`).** Send the access token in the STOMP
CONNECT frame (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). Every event is
`{event, timestamp, data}` and is also published on `/topic/events`:

| event | topic | data |
|---|---|---|
| SENSOR_READING_UPDATED | /topic/telemetry | device + readings of one message |
| DEVICE_STATUS_CHANGED | /topic/devices | DeviceStatus |
| ACTUATOR_STATUS_CHANGED | /topic/actuators | ActuatorStatus |
| ACTUATOR_UPDATED | /topic/actuators | Actuator (settings changed) |
| ACTUATOR_COMMAND_UPDATED | /topic/actuators/commands | ActuatorCommand |
| SENSOR_UPDATED | /topic/sensors | Sensor (registered, renamed, enabled/disabled) |
| ALERT_CREATED, ALERT_UPDATED | /topic/alerts | Alert |
| AI_DETECTION_CREATED | /topic/ai | AiDetection |

Running in DEVELOPMENT mode.

get.description: Read-only file from the edge agent's photo folder (CAPTURES_DIR), e.g. /captures/2026-10-22/20261022-1905_S03_timur.png. Same Bearer token as the API, so a browser must fetch it and show the blob; a plain gets 401. 404 when CAPTURES_DIR is not set or the file does not exist.
Public. {"status":"UP"} when the backend and its database are reachable.

put.description: The only cultivation setting in the app: HST and the growth phase on the dashboard are counted from this date.

post.description: The new user is asked to change the password at first sign-in unless mustChangePassword is false.
Revokes every session of the account; the user must change it at next sign-in.

get.description: Optionally filtered to a single device. Disabled sensors (not installed, retired, or auto-registered and not yet reviewed) are left out unless includeDisabled=true, which the settings screen uses to review and enable them.

post.description: measuredValue defaults to the sensor's latest reading.

get.summary: Calibration models of a sensor, newest validFrom first

post.summary: Enter a calibration model computed elsewhere
post.description: calibrated = intercept + slope x raw + Σ coef x covariate. Missing fit statistics are computed from the stored lab samples.

post.summary: Fit a calibration model from the lab samples
post.description: Ordinary least squares on raw value plus optional covariates; reports R², RMSE, MAE and Bland-Altman. Previews unless save = true.

get.summary: Paired lab samples of a sensor, newest first

post.description: sensorValue and covariates default to the sensor's telemetry message at sampledAt.

post.summary: Send a test notification to every browser of the signed-in account

post.description: Body is JSON.stringify(pushSubscription). 201 when new, 200 when it already existed.

delete.description: Call it on sign-out and when the user turns notifications off.

get.description: active=true for the dashboard; omit for all.

post.description: Send the name the farmer typed; a unique code is made from it.

get.description: With the next start and the result of the last run.

post.description: time is farm time (WIB) HH:mm; durationSeconds at most the pump's maxRunSeconds. A time that has already passed today starts tomorrow. 409 for a duplicate time or a too long duration.
Devices may also appear automatically on first contact when auto-registration is enabled.
Runs the same ingestion, validation and WebSocket push as a broker message.

post.summary: Fill the database with one growing season of sensor history
post.description: For every catalog sensor: hourly rollups for old days and raw readings every 5 minutes for the last days. Planting cycles and plants are left to the operator. Safe to repeat: existing data is never overwritten.

post.summary: Send an arbitrary status message as if it came from the device
post.description: Use the actuators map to simulate reported actuator states, and powerSource (MAINS / BATTERY) to simulate an outage.

post.summary: Send a heartbeat as if it came from the device
Acknowledge a command as if the device had executed it
post.description: Lets the full command lifecycle, up to EXECUTED, be exercised without hardware.

post.summary: Raise an alert as if the edge agent had detected a fault
post.description: For example {"type": "SSR_SHORT", "severity": "CRITICAL", "actuatorCode": "DIST-PUMP"}.

post.summary: Send an AI detection as if it came from the device
Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: The refresh token is single-use: the previous one is revoked. 401 when it is unknown, expired, revoked or the account is disabled.

401.description: Refresh token no longer valid; sign in again

post.description: Revokes the given refresh token. Always 204, even for an unknown token.
Returns a short-lived JWT access token (Authorization: Bearer) and a refresh token that keeps the session alive for days.
Requires the current password. Every other session of the account is revoked; a fresh token pair is returned for this device.

get.description: Disabled actuators (not installed or retired) are left out unless includeDisabled=true, which the settings screen uses to re-enable one.

get.summary: List the command history of an actuator

post.description:
Persists an audit record, then publishes the command to the device. A 202 means the
command reached the messaging layer, not that the hardware acted on it - watch the
command status, which only becomes EXECUTED when the device acknowledges it.

503.description: Messaging infrastructure unavailable; the attempt is still recorded as FAILED

get.summary: Flow calibrations of a pump, newest first

post.description: Send the trials (at least 3) and the flow is total volume / total time; or send flowMlPerSecond directly.

patch.description: You cannot change your own role or disable yourself; the last active admin is protected.
Used to name and enable a sensor that was auto-registered from telemetry.

patch.summary: Change a watering time, its duration, or switch it on/off

patch.description: Records the signed-in operator as the one who acknowledged it.
Rename, enable or disable an output, or change its run-time limit (0 removes it).

get.description: UTF-8 with BOM, times in WIB; covariates become columns.

get.summary: Get the most recent reading for a sensor

get.description: Defaults to the last 24 hours when no range is supplied.

get.summary: Get min/avg/max of a sensor per time interval
get.description: For long-range charts. Defaults to the last 7 days. Points are aligned to the farm time                     zone (a 1d point starts at local midnight, 7d on Monday) and empty intervals are omitted.                     Intervals of 1h and wider also cover data older than the raw-reading retention; narrower                     intervals only cover the retention window. Raw values, not calibrated.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive range end, ISO-8601 instant; defaults to now

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Point width: 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 3h, 6h, 12h, 1d or 7d. Omit to get about 300 points.

get.summary: Whether push is available and the VAPID public key
get.description: Pass publicKey as applicationServerKey to pushManager.subscribe().

delete.description: AI detections that pointed at it are kept without the plant. Deleting the LAST plant also clears the transplant date (GET /api/cultivation/active becomes 404), so the next season starts again from adding the first plant.

get.description: Includes the configured offline timeout so the client does not hard-code it.

get.summary: Show what the backend would have published
get.description: Only available while the mock transport is active (app.mqtt.enabled=false).

get.summary: Everything the main dashboard needs, in one request
get.description:
Returns system status, device liveness, the latest reading of every enabled sensor,
actuator states, open alerts, the latest AI detection and a recent activity feed.
Live updates arrive over the WebSocket connection; this endpoint is for the initial
render and for reconnects.
HST counted from the transplant date, the phase in effect with its EC target (phases follow the AI team's fuzzy), and the next phase. 404 when the transplant date is not set.

get.summary: Describe the account behind the current token

get.description: Newest first. Every filter is optional and they combine: acknowledgement state, severity, and the related device, sensor or actuator.

get.summary: Sensor snapshot for the AI service's fuzzy forms
get.description: Field names match the AI service forms (run_fertilization, run_irrigation). Calibrated values when available. A field whose reading is missing or older than app.ai.inputs.max-age is null and listed in problems; do not dose unless readyForFertilization is true (safety rule S9).
Labels and scores are reported by the model; the backend stores them without interpreting them. Filters are exclusive: stationCode, then deviceId, then detectionType.

get.summary: Get the last state the device reported for an actuator
get.description: Null until the device reports one; the backend does not infer state from commands.
Σ run time of EXECUTED activating commands x the flow calibrated before each run. Defaults to the last 24 hours.

get.summary: Get one command by its commandUid
get.description: The commandUid is returned by POST /api/actuators/{id}/commands. Poll it until status is EXECUTED or FAILED (failureCode tells why, e.g. NO_RESPONSE, INTERLOCK_POWER).

True after an admin reset or on a new account: the client should ask for a new password

metricKey.description: Namespaced with a dot when one device has several instruments of the same kind

metricKey.description: Key this sensor uses inside a telemetry payload

autoRegistered.description: Created automatically from an unrecognised telemetry metric

metadata.description: Informational hardware binding; never used for decisions

measuredValue.description: Value read in the standard; defaults to the sensor's latest reading

probeCleaned.description: Probe was cleaned before this check (Protokol §7 step 6)

deviationPercent.description: deviation / reference x 100; null when the reference is 0

covariates.description: Covariate metricKey -> coefficient; empty for a plain linear model

validFrom.description: Readings recorded from this instant on use the model; defaults to now

id.description: Null for an unsaved fit preview

loaLower.description: Bland-Altman lower limit of agreement, bias - 1.96 SD

loaUpper.description: Bland-Altman upper limit of agreement, bias + 1.96 SD

current.description: True for the calibration applied to new readings

covariateKeys.description: Covariate metric keys, e.g. soil moisture and temperature (Protokol §7 step 4)

samplesFrom.description: Only samples taken from this instant on

samplesTo.description: Only samples taken up to this instant

save.description: Store the result as the sensor's calibration; false (default) only previews it

validFrom.description: When saved: readings from this instant on use the model; defaults to now

sampledAt.description: When the soil sample was taken; defaults to now

sensorValue.description: Raw sensor value at that moment; defaults to the latest reading

covariates.description: Covariate metricKey -> value; defaults to the other metrics of the same telemetry message

removed.description: Subscriptions the push service no longer knows; removed

name.description: Free text the farmer types. Name or code is required.

code.description: Optional; made from the name when empty

durationSeconds.description: Seconds; at most the pump's maxRunSeconds

nextRunAt.description: Next start; null when disabled or irrigation scheduling is switched off

lastResult.description: STARTED, SKIPPED (refused by a safety rule), FAILED, MISSED (backend was down)

lastReasonCode.description: Why it was skipped/failed/missed: an interlock code (BACKUP_POWER, FLOAT_LOW, EXCLUSIVE_OPERATION, BLOCKED_WHILE_ACTIVE, DEVICE_NOT_ONLINE), an API error code, PUMP_UNAVAILABLE or BACKEND_DOWN. Translate this, not lastMessage.

lastMessage.description: Technical detail; English for safety refusals

lastCommandUid.description: Command of the last run; GET /api/actuators/commands/{commandUid}

powerSource.description: Last power source the device reported

timestamp.description: Device-side timestamp; defaults to now when omitted

details.description: Field-level details, present for validation errors

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token; send it to /api/auth/refresh before expiresAt passes

refreshExpiresAt.description: When the refresh token, and with it the session, ends

maxRunSeconds.description: Longest run one activating command may request; omit for no limit

metadata.description: Informational hardware binding, e.g. Modbus address and channel

type.description: Free text; the hardware catalogue decides the values

currentState.description: Last state reported by the device

maxRunSeconds.description: Longest run one activating command may request; null means no limit

supportedCommands.description: Command names this actuator accepts; null when its type is unrestricted

metadata.description: Informational hardware binding; never used for decisions

command.description: Command name understood by the device

parameters.description: Free-form arguments passed through to the device

commandUid.description: Correlation id echoed by the device in its acknowledgement

requestedBy.description: Username that requested it; null for automation and system commands

failureCode.description: Reason code from a failed device acknowledgement, e.g. INTERLOCK_POWER; null when the failure carried no code

busVoltage.description: Bus voltage during the test; defaults to the latest mains voltage reading

trials.description: [{durationSeconds, volumeMl}] when trials were recorded one by one

flowCvPercent.description: Coefficient of variation of the per-trial flow, %

current.description: True for the calibration used for new commands

metadata.description: Machine-readable details, e.g. failureCode (NO_RESPONSE, INTERLOCK_POWER, ...), commandUid; route on these, not on the message text

maxRunSeconds.description: New run-time limit in seconds; 0 removes the limit

calibratedValue.description: Value corrected by the sensor's calibration valid at recordedAt; null when the sensor has no calibration or a covariate is missing. The raw value is never changed.

receivedAt.description: Timestamp the backend received the message

bucketStart.description: Start of this point; it covers [bucketStart, bucketStart + interval)

count.description: Number of raw readings behind this point

from.description: Start of the first point, aligned to the interval in the farm time zone

enabled.description: False when the server has no VAPID keys; hide the notification toggle

publicKey.description: applicationServerKey for pushManager.subscribe(); null when disabled

minSeverity.description: Alerts of this severity and above are pushed

subscriptions.description: Browsers subscribed for the signed-in account

powerSource.description: Last power source the device reported; null if it never reports one

onBackupPower.description: True when the reported power source is not a configured normal supply

label.description: Class reported by the model; null for a scores-only multi-label result

scores.description: Label to score map from a multi-label model, stored as reported

panDirection.description: Camera direction at the station: TIMUR or BARAT

refId.description: Alert id for ALERT entries, command id for ACTUATOR_COMMAND entries

failureCode.description: ACTUATOR_COMMAND: failure code of a FAILED command; ALERT: metadata.failureCode, or metadata.reasonCode (e.g. BACKUP_POWER for IRRIGATION_SKIPPED); otherwise null

alertType.description: Alert type for ALERT entries; null for commands

latestAiDetection.description: Null until the vision model reports something

cultivation.description: Null when no planting cycle is active

latestReadings.description: Latest value of every enabled sensor

value.description: Calibrated value when the sensor has a calibration, else raw

maxAgeSeconds.description: Readings older than this are stale

hst.description: Days since the transplant date; null when it is not set in Settings

readyForFertilization.description: All fertilization fields present, fresh, and HST known

readyForIrrigation.description: All irrigation fields present, fresh, and HST known

fertilization.description: Form fields for run_fertilization: ec, ph, nitrogen_tanah, phosfor_tanah, kalium_tanah, hst

irrigation.description: Form fields for run_irrigation: ec_air, suhu_air, suhu_udara, rh, humidity_tanah, temp_tanah, ph, nitrogen, phosfor, kalium, ec_tanah, hst

readings.description: Per metric key: the reading behind each field

problems.description: Why a form is not ready, e.g. "fertilization.ph (tank.ph): stale, 1820 s old"

runCount.description: Executed activating commands that started in the range

volumeMl.description: Sum of run time x the flow calibrated before each run; null when no run was calibrated

uncalibratedRunCount.description: Runs with no calibration before them; counted in totalSeconds but not in volumeMl

unknownDurationRunCount.description: Runs whose duration is unknown (no duration parameter)

currentFlowMlPerSecond.description: Flow of the current calibration, mL/s; null when never calibrated

currentCalibratedAt.description: When the current calibration was made
